theorem lg_target (n : ℕ) (hn : 3 ≤ n) : n ^ 2 ≥ 2 * n + 3 := by
  have h1 : n ^ 2 - 2 * n - 3 = (n - 3) * (n + 1) := by ring_nf
  have h2 : (n - 3) * (n + 1) ≥ 0 :=
    begin
      have h3 : n - 3 ≥ 0 := by linarith
      have h4 : n + 1 ≥ 0 := by linarith
      exact mul_nonneg h3 h4
    end
  rw h1 at h2
  exact h2
